turns.officerText: I am calling from the Hyderabad office, but the incident is at the Chennai facility north loading area. A colleague there reported an unresponsive employee. No breathing has been observed. The colleague cannot confirm an injury or a weapon. Immediate medical help is required at the Chennai facility, not at my Hyderabad office.
